## Overview

This backward-compatible release adds a continuous scroll view for slide decks and renders GitHub-style
`[!NOTE]`, `[!TIP]`, `[!IMPORTANT]`, `[!WARNING]`, and `[!CAUTION]` block quotes with semantic theme
colors. PowerPoint export preserves alert titles and bodies as native text over decorative artwork.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible. Existing Markdown decks continue to work; alert block quotes
and continuous scroll view are optional authoring and viewing features.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.3.1`. |
| Slide viewing | Choose Scroll view or Fixed preview from the view controls as needed. |
| GitHub alert blocks | Optionally use top-level `> [!NOTE]`, `> [!TIP]`, `> [!IMPORTANT]`, `> [!WARNING]`, or `> [!CAUTION]` block quotes. |
